claims.name: eleven-statement-family-immutable-recurrence
claims.statement: Fresh eleven-contract statement-family recurrence supplies all3864 regular Git inputs from the immutable activation commit, without overlays. Four unchanged focused fixtures pass80 complete groups. Sixty-six Toolbox inspections retain177 authored scalar frames and111 exact original event origins, including original reference identities; all three-seed full compiler channels equal the prior guarded boundary exactly. Three foreign-source probes preserve their declaration events with no invented origins. Fifteen reason-specific acceptance controls observe RED, six diagnostic-context controls and six render controls reject corruptions. Two source-bound failed replays reproduce their original errors with all six displayed logical frames matching executed source. Five original examples render from58 complete book inputs. All61 original prior producer-claim input hashes verify before its historical mode/revision-only freeze.
claims.scope: The eleven basic statement contracts and their private splitter/producer/source-authority composition only. This is a new immutable activation-boundary recurrence, not relabeled prior observations or a new behavior change. The supplied regular Git population is a conservative input superset, not minimal observed IO; original bytes, modes, object identities and excluded metadata are recoverable at ab2c0b9357007aab31302e01c9f4a73aaf2fc5c8. Every actual recurrence command has complete before/after population/content/mode guards and full stdout/stderr. Current Perl/spec/test bytes must still equal those immutable members during review. Exact original authored segments independently define Unicode scalar intervals and event occurrence indices; no equal-raw search. Unknown/copied/transformed/foreign callbacks decline fabricated frames while retaining existing events; the permanent fixtures cover nesting, error state, callback signatures/counts and original array/event identity. Two initial reviewer defects and the renamed-file selection attempts retain original source and actual failed channels separately; only the reviewer is repaired. Complete publication inputs and rendered HTML remain a separate captured boundary. Host OS/Perl/Python standard libraries and PATH-resolved prove/mdBook are necessary read-only prerequisites. Project scratch is repository-local on the same volume. Gitlinks/non-regular entries are excluded without dependency payload reads. Canonical CI is an independently required exact staged-receipt landing condition; this record does not publish a canonical CI measurement. Wider twenty-contract composition, remaining producers, executable membership, comment semantics, source replacement, arbitrary host syntax, malicious callback mutation, cross-host/backend admission and global historical audit remain separately owned.
